87:def _handle_verify_gates(runtime: 'ExperimentRuntime', params: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
88:    required = tuple(runtime.spec.verification_gates)
89:    supplied = params.get('gate_evidence') or params.get('evidence')
90:    # Historical records preserve their declared state, but are never a source
91:    # of a fresh live promotion.  Every live result must point at sealed input.
92:    if supplied is None:
93:        legacy = dict(params.get('gate_results') or {})
94:        if runtime.spec.status == 'released_historical_non_invocable' and legacy:
95:            if set(legacy) != set(required):
96:                raise RuntimeError('historical gate declaration must name exactly the required gates')
97:            runtime.gate_results.update({gate: bool(legacy[gate]) for gate in required})
98:            return {'gates': dict(runtime.gate_results), 'authority': 'HISTORICAL_DECLARATION_ONLY'}
99:        if required:
100:            raise RuntimeError('verify.gates requires sealed gate_evidence for every required gate')
101:        return {'gates': dict(runtime.gate_results)}
102:    if not isinstance(supplied, Mapping):
103:        raise RuntimeError('gate_evidence must be an object keyed by gate id')
104:    unknown = set(supplied) - set(required)
105:    missing = set(required) - set(supplied)
106:    if unknown or missing:
107:        raise RuntimeError(f'gate evidence must exactly match required gates; missing={sorted(missing)}, unknown={sorted(unknown)}')
108:    for gate in required:
109:        candidate = supplied[gate]
110:        if isinstance(candidate, Mapping):
111:            # A sealed inline record is persisted before it is read back; this
112:            # prevents an ephemeral object from becoming promotion authority.
113:            gate_path = runtime.receipts.write_gate_evidence(candidate)
114:        elif isinstance(candidate, str):
115:            gate_path = _existing_workspace_path(candidate)
116:            if not gate_path.is_absolute():
117:                gate_path = runtime.work_dir / gate_path
118:        else:
119:            raise RuntimeError(f'gate evidence for {gate!r} must be a sealed object or path')
120:        evidence = runtime.receipts.read_gate_evidence(gate_path, expected_gate=gate)
121:        runtime.gate_evidence[gate] = evidence
122:        runtime.gate_results[gate] = evidence.result == 'PASS'
123:        if evidence.result != 'PASS':
124:            raise RuntimeError(f'gate {gate!r} is sealed as {evidence.result}; promotion is refused')
125:    return {
126:        'gates': dict(runtime.gate_results),
127:        'gate_evidence': {gate: str(runtime.receipts.gate_path_for(gate)) for gate in required},
128:    }
